title: Orders failing at market open again

acceptableCauses.mechanism: A config change on Friday cut order-service's DB pool from 100 to 20 connections; at the open the pool saturated and orders timed out acquiring connections.

partialCredit.reason: Finds the saturated pool but not the config change that caused it.

keyCounterevidence: broker-connector shows no 429s or upstream errors; broker latency is normal.
Errors are connection-pool timeouts inside order-service, not broker rejections.
redHerrings: past incidents: broker outage/limit at the open
notes: A similar past incident is a lead, not proof.
